Quality Engineer
Responsibilities
1. Own the quality management system and lead internal ISO 9001 audits.
2. Use SPC and control charts to monitor critical processes.
3. Lead 8D root cause analysis for customer complaints.
4. Work with machinists to hold the desired tolerances on CNC parts.
Qualifications
1. BS in Mechanical, Industrial or Quality Engineering.
2. 3+ years of experience with APQP/PPAP in an IATF 16949 environment.
3. Working knowledge of GD&T and CMM inspection.
4. Experience with at least one of the following:
   a. Minitab
   b. SQL
Preferred
1. ASQ CQE certification.
2. Six Sigma Green Belt.
3. Experience with SAP QM.
Compensation
1) Base salary $80,000-$95,000
2) Annual bonus
